title: Request for a feature to inhibit copying of private information
body:
Is there an easy way to block the application from copying information from these sources? At least the most important ones would be credit card numbers and passwords from managers like Bitwarden and Proton Pass

Password managers
Credit card number
Phone number
Email address
author: mooncakke

comments.body:
Hi @mooncakke 
You can filter specific apps by copying text from them and selecting `More -> Filter this source`.
It's possible do the same in `Settings -> Storage -> Owner app filter`
interesting, I'll make some adjustments and see how it works, thanks :D

title: Please change the tab order of controls
body:
First, thank you for this tiny, but very great app! It's the best clipboard manager I've seen. 

Now the wish: please change the tab order of controls, so hitting the "Tab" button (unlike Shift+Tab at this time) would first focus the search field, then "Home" button, then "Favorites", and so on. This will be much more convenient than now. (Now Tab focus "Home" first and search field last)
author: boroda74

comments.body:
Hi @boroda74 
When you open the window, default list of items is automatically focused (first element in the list). I wanted to make pasting using only the up/down arrows and the Enter key.
If it is important for you to have the focus on the search bar first, you can enable this in settings: `General -> Search box focus`
Yes, the list is focused by default, and this is fine. I mean that now hitting Tab key once focuses "Home" button. It would be great if hitting Tab key ones focused search field instead.
Good point, thanks for the suggestion

Just updated logic for tab indexes
In next release it will be changed/fixed
One question: will the next release be on the MS Store, or is it better to uninstall Store version and install GitHub version?

@boroda74 all my releases are in MS Store after I publish it. I don't provide on-side installers for now.
But if you want to try it now, you can build dev-version by yourself in any time. And there is no need to uninstall MS Store version
Ok, no problem, I'll wait for the next release.
